facets.description: store.js.es6:197–201 unconditionally replaces and deletes raw *_ids arrays even when lookups fail, losing ids and producing undefined entries.
store.js.es6:200 can overwrite an existing field with the pluralized relationship property.
store.js.es6:197 calls .map on potentially null *_ids values, crashing hydration.
store.js.es6:200 has an ineffective || [] fallback because map always returns an array.
